'''Carannia''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].

==Description==
Carannia was the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that proceeded it. It was one of the three largest cities on the planet, the other two being [[Saffia/Legends|Saffia]] and [[Fiyarro]]. These cities were well known for their citizens' anti-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] tendencies and served as a home to some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] wealthiest benefactors.<ref name="DB:ROT" /> The capital, which was built on the shore of the [[Belsallian Sea/Legends|Belsallian Sea]], was also known for its vast, open-air markets which contained goods and services brought to the world from all across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The six wealthiest and most powerful families lived here.

==History==
[[File:Carannia.png|thumb|right|150px|Carannia, on the waterfront of the [[Belsallian Sea/Legends|Belsallian Sea]].]]
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Jahan Cross]] fought with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] near the cities water front in an attempt to prevent the completion of a mission Fett was on. This took place 10 days after the prior had assassinated [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Adan Dooku]] of [[House Dooku]], the count of Serenno at the time of his, whilst he visited the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="HT1" />
